summary.en: China edition of Alibaba's terminal AI coding assistant; 1.1.97 ships a qoderclicn-windows-arm64 zip.
summary.zh-TW: 阿里巴巴終端機 AI 編碼助手的中國版，1.1.97 版提供 qoderclicn-windows-arm64 壓縮檔。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Only the installer architecture in the winget manifest was confirmed; runtime behavior is untested.
caveats.zh-TW: 只確認了 winget 資訊清單中的安裝檔架構，執行行為尚未驗證。
